LESSON: SCRIPTURAL TEXT AND ROLE OF SIKH SCRIPTURES SAHIB IN SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI 17

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do the Scriptures influence your lifestyle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation
2. appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SCRIPTURAL TEXT AND ROLE OF SIKH SCRIPTURES SAHIB IN SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI 17
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SCRIPTURAL TEXT AND ROLE OF SIKH SCRIPTURES SAHIB IN SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI 17
Study Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 in your own words. (skill: appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do the Scriptures influence your lifestyle?
2. How does the recitation of the Scriptures help to acquire self-efficacy?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation.
5. Be able to: appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
